items: Mens Beach Flip Flops：Mens flip flops wide strap is spliced by casting leather and delicate two-tone webbing, which makes the shoes more colorful and textured. The toe post is made of soft and skin-friendly fabric, without burrs, and will not scratch the toes during walking.

Orthotic Arch Support：Mens Athletic flip flops incorporate corrective arch support and deep heel cup. Ergonomically designed arch support can help you relieve foot/arch/heel pain, plantar fasciitis, tendinitis, etc. Proper heel depth can stabilize the heel and improve the stability during walking.
Yoga Mat Insole：Mens orthotic thong sandals' footbed is made of yoga mat, which can provide comfortable cushioning and shock absorption during daily walking.

Non-slip & Waterproof Sole：Mens shower flip flops have a anti-slip rubber sole for strong grip and ensure no slipping. Very suitable for summer hiking, boating trips, beach walking, swimming pools and other outdoor wear.

Best Fashion Choice：Men's flip flops are designed in a sporty style, suitable for all male. It is a great gift for father, boyfriend or friends on birthday, Father's Day, Valentine's Day and Thanksgiving Day. Please refer to our men's shoe size chart to purchase.
